recursive_dimension_domain: integer layer index over a verified finite window
spacetime_dimension_relation: delta is a computational nesting index, not a physical spacetime dimension

formalism.host_relation: Host(W_delta,W_delta+1) means W_delta supplies the physical/computational substrate on which W_delta+1 is instantiated
formalism.finite_certificate: Cert_N=AND_{delta=m..n}(R_delta AND D_delta AND I_delta AND T_delta)
formalism.reason: a finite UTM execution can certify only a bounded observed prefix; it cannot establish an actually infinite tower

delta_0.name: observed-world substrate
delta_0.possible_parent: delta_-1 is an admissible hypothesis but is not evidenced by this model

obligations.R: bounded recursion relation is well formed and cycle-free within the certified window
obligations.D: recursive dimension indices and parent-child increments are consistent
obligations.I: each child transition is tied to an identified interpreter/program/state lineage
obligations.T: thermodynamic-information guard obligations are inherited at every finalized layer

information_rule.child_finality: a child commit is canonical only after its own integrity/durability certificate is accepted
information_rule.parent_dependency: loss of every physical copy of a child state can still destroy that child; recursion does not create storage ex nihilo
information_rule.anti_tamper: each finalized layer must preserve verifiable lineage to its parent checkpoint and its own append-only history

scope: formal computational recursion model only; it permits, but does not establish, the hypothesis that the observed physical world itself has an external computational host
